prebuilds.blurb: A complete, fully assembled Trak Racer TR120S V2 package with Simagic direct-drive hardware, triple 32" curved monitors, and a racing-optimised PC for proper motorsport feel at home.
capabilities: Direct-drive force feedback for formula, GT and prototype practice
Load-cell style braking consistency on P1000 pedals
Sequential shifting and handbrake for rally, drift and single-seater work
Triple-screen immersion for mirror and apex awareness
Ready for iRacing, ACC, rFactor and major racing titles
Stable seating position for longer stints
prebuilds.description:
This Starter Rig centres on the Trak Racer TR120S V2 chassis, delivered fully assembled and ready for serious practice sessions. Simagic’s Alpha EVO 12 Nm direct-drive wheelbase pairs with the GT NEO wheel, P1000 pedals, sequential shifter and handbrake so you get clean force feedback, consistent pedal travel and proper shift/handbrake inputs without upgrading later.

A racing-optimised gaming PC drives triple 32" curved monitors for wide visibility in iRacing, ACC and other titles, while the surround sound system fills in engine and tyre detail. A touring seat and side mounts keep the driving position stable and the shifter/handbrake within easy reach.

Built for Australian sim racers who want a practical, premium baseline rather than a piecemeal setup. Everything is chosen to work together out of the box so you can focus on lap times, not cable management or compatibility headaches.
highlights: TR120S V2 chassis, fully assembled
Simagic Alpha EVO 12 Nm direct drive
GT NEO wheel, P1000 pedals, sequential shifter and handbrake
Triple 32" curved monitors
Racing-optimised PC and surround sound
Touring seat with side mounts
prebuilds.name: Starter Rig

prebuilds.description:
This haptic-focused Exodus XR1 rig is built for Australian sim racers who want professional-grade feedback without motion complexity. The heavy-duty XR1 chassis pairs with a free-standing quad monitor frame, delivering wide visibility across three curved 32-inch AOC panels plus a dedicated auxiliary screen for telemetry or spotter info.

At the core is the Simagic Alpha 15 Nm wheelbase with GT Neo rim, matched to P1000 pedals with hydraulic brake and integrated haptics, plus a sequential shifter. A large touring seat keeps long stints comfortable, while Logitech surround sound and a Pro X headset round out the audio package.

The included high-performance PC (12th-gen i9 class, RTX 5070 Ti, fast Samsung storage and DDR5) is ready for iRacing and modern titles. Custom livery, a Sprintcar iRacing skin and a 12-month subscription complete a turn-key package that feels race-ready from the moment you sit down.
highlights: Exodus XR1 chassis with touring seat
Simagic Alpha 15 Nm + GT Neo + haptic P1000
Free-standing quad monitor setup (3x 32-inch + aux)
Sequential shifter and full audio package
Race PC with RTX 5070 Ti class GPU
Custom livery, iRacing skin and 12-month sub
prebuilds.name: Haptic Racing Rig

prebuilds.description:
The Exodus XR1 Full-Motion package is built for drivers who want a serious, long-term simulator rather than a temporary setup. The heavy-duty XR1 frame anchors a free-standing quad monitor mount, touring seat and full Simagic control stack, giving you a stable platform that holds alignment under hard use.

Motion comes from the Simrigs SR2 system, paired with an Alpha 15 Nm wheelbase, GT Neo wheel, P1000 pedals with hydraulic brake and haptics, and a sequential shifter. Triple AOC 32-inch 240 Hz curved screens plus a 27-inch auxiliary display cover the main view and telemetry, while Logitech surround and a Pro X headset handle audio.

The build includes a high-performance gaming PC specified for triple-screen racing titles, custom simulator livery, a custom Sprintcar skin for iRacing and a 12-month iRacing subscription. Everything is selected to work together as a complete, ready-to-drive package for Australian sim racers who want immersion without guesswork.
highlights: Exodus XR1 heavy-duty chassis with free-standing quad monitor frame
Simrigs SR2 full-motion platform
Simagic Alpha 15 Nm, GT Neo, P1000 haptics and sequential shifter
Triple AOC 32-inch 240 Hz curved displays plus 27-inch aux screen
Race-spec PC with RTX 5070 Ti-class graphics
Custom livery, iRacing Sprintcar skin and 12-month subscription
prebuilds.name: Exodus XR1 Full-Motion

prebuilds.description:
Built for Australian sim racers who want to match or beat the usual flagship packages without the runaround. This rig centres on a rigid cockpit, a high-torque Simagic Alpha base, and P1000 pedals with haptic feedback so braking and kerb feel stay consistent through long stints.

The GT-style wheel, sequential shifter, and handbrake cover GT, formula, and rally-style disciplines out of the box. A touring seat and side mounts keep the driving position locked in, while the 32-inch primary display and mounting hardware leave a clear path to expand the view when you are ready.

We spec a dedicated race PC and surround audio so the bundle is genuinely plug-in-and-drive, not a partial shopping list. Finished on the Gold Coast by Everything Simulated with practical cable routing and a setup you can live with day to day.
highlights: 15 Nm direct-drive wheelbase for clear tyre and chassis detail
P1000 pedals with haptics for consistent threshold braking
Sequential shifter and handbrake for full discipline coverage
Touring seat and side mounts for a locked-in driving position
Race PC and 32-inch display included for a complete desk-to-grid path
prebuilds.name: Flagship Rival
